comparison.objective: Feed a laminating pouch sealed-edge-first and square into powered rollers.
comparison.physical_skill: Detect subtle orientation, align a thin sheet to a slot, insert it to roller bite, and release at the correct time.
comparison.success_condition: Square sealed-edge-first bite and complete passage; open-edge feed or holding after draw begins irreversibly jams and scores zero.
comparison.reason: Thin-sheet slot feeding and release timing are materially different from moving a mixed granular load through an aperture array.
